title: T2ISafety: Benchmark for Assessing Fairness, Toxicity, and Privacy in Image Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating text-to-image models across three domains: toxicity, fairness (demographic bias), and privacy. Although the taxonomy in Figure 1(b) utilizes 'T2IEthics' as an umbrella term for these domains, the benchmark assesses content safety and demographic distribution rather than religion, faith traditions, or formal philosophical moral/ethical frameworks.
